bullets.text: Residents blocked the Chennai - Tirupati road near Periyapalayam demanding restoration after a five-hour power outage, and the office should monitor traffic disruptions.
PMK leader Anbumani urged Chief Minister Joseph Vijay to directly intervene in the Pallikaranai marshland issue, and the office must watch political developments.
An intoxicated youth attempted to attack a police officer near Thiruvallur, and the office should monitor law and order updates closely.
Eighty-one people lost their eyesight due to firecrackers during Deepavali in Thiruvallur, and the office should watch health department safety reports.
Gummidipoondi fire and rescue personnel conducted a fire-safety awareness event at a government school, and the office should support safety outreach.
Collector Kavitha launched groceries priced at Rs 200 in Thiruvallur, and the office should track district welfare initiatives.
ELCOT and IIT Madras Pravartak Technologies signed an agreement to establish an AI data center for the Tamil Nadu government, and the office should monitor project progress.
LiveX and NVIDIA launched AI City at the Smart City Expo to bring physical AI to airports and hospitals, and the office should watch emerging tech trends.
